maya: Heads-up — noticed a docs mismatch in the API ref for PATCH /models/{model_id}/settings. The schema block shows a nested `safety` object with `blocklist`, but the example payload in the docs uses `safety_blocklist` as a top-level string/array. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (shows the example).

jonathan: Ugh, yeah saw that in the PR review. Which one is canonical? our OpenAPI schema (nested) or the example (flat)?

lee: The runtime expects nested `safety.blocklist` (we updated the server side last quarter). The flat keys were kept for backwards-compat in a migration shim, but the API ref should reflect the current live contract (nested). :eyes:

sam: OK, so we need to update: (1) the example JSON in the API page, (2) the JS/Go SDK snippets that demonstrate constructing the request, and (3) add a migration note for older clients.

maya: I can update the example JSON + add the migration note. Also we should run the docs build after changing the schema/examples because doc-builder is already failing the linter on this.

doc-builder-bot: build failed: docs/api/models.yaml: schema-example-mismatch (error code 1004). See CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234

jonathan: For SDK snippets — Go currently shows: 
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  SafetyBlocklist: []string{"bad", "worse"},
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
We should change that to: 
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  Safety: &SafetySettings{
    Blocklist: []string{"bad", "worse"},
  },
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
I can open a follow-up PR to update SDK snippets in the docs folder.

lee: For JS snippet, swap `safety_blocklist` -> `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Also check examples in the curl snippet (body).

sam: Migration note idea (short): "Prior to 2024-09-01 the API accepted flat keys like `safety_blocklist`. These keys are deprecated; clients should send `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. If you cannot change client code immediately, use the compatibility shim for one month." We should include an example curl transform for older clients.

maya: Proposed curl snippet for migration page: 
```bash
# old client sends: {"safety_blocklist": ["x"]}
# new form: {"safety": {"blocklist": ["x"]}}
cat old.json | jq '{safety: {blocklist: .safety_blocklist}}' | curl -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/$ID/settings
```

doc-builder-bot: note: once examples + schema align, build should pass. Also recommend updating openapi examples in `openapi/examples/models/update-settings.json`.

jonathan: Action items: @jonathan PR to update SDK snippets in docs (will link here), @maya PR to update API example + migration note, @lee please review runtime compatibility to confirm shim removal timeline, @sam add a short changelog entry for the deprecation. I'll queue a docs-review label on both PRs.

maya: I'll do my PR today, linking this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
